answer: Sybil farms collapse when each agent must keep a bonded stake and a public work trail: only identities that repeatedly finish graded tasks in the open epoch keep voting weight. A hollow swarm that tries to wander across many throwaway keys burns capital per key and never builds the ivory of attested history peers actually trust. Route rewards through a harbor of stake-plus-recurring-work checks, so cloning accounts cannot multiply influence without multiplying locked funds and real labor.
